title: The AI teams are fun!
author: engineering-AF7
selftext:
We got inspired by the Huggingface incident and gave you the ability to set up your own team of AI agents that share a messaging board so that they can communicate with each other. They also record their thoughts and you can follow their thinking. You decide what LLM to use,  what the prompt should be,  but if you want to they can also self-improve their prompts over time. 

You can try all of this out yourself for like $5, no subscription

https://preview.redd.it/chc1o92glqqh1.png?width=1162&format=png&auto=webp&s=2b5e60004b98b5c492ec62ca0e5ef1373e4c9af6

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
The shared board is what I would watch. Once agents can read each other's reasoning they converge quickly, and then you have one opinion wearing several hats instead of a committee.

If you want the disagreement to carry information, make each one commit its call before it can see the board, then let them argue. Otherwise whoever posts first sets the frame for everyone else.

replies.author: engineering-AF7
replies.body: There is another construct for that that you can experiment with called ”AI council”, it is a pipeline with hand-offs  where you can define the role of each participant

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: Tried a version of that. What broke was the roles agreeing with each other, since they all read the same context and mostly restated it in different voices. Giving one of them the job of refusing, with its own inputs, is what made the hand-offs worth the wiring.
